description: Read one decision of the Supreme Court of the Slovak Republic (NS SR) with its text in slices. Give exactly one key: id (uuid from sk-judikatura_search or sk-judikatura_lookup), ecli, or cislo (the case number as printed, for example 8Cdo/21/2014, written with its slash and not encoded). ecli and cislo can match several rows. Returns the extremes (court, cislo, senat, ecli, datum_rozhodnutia, kolegium, kolegium_nazov, merito, sudca), the text slice (offset 0-based, length 1..50000 characters, default 20000), text_length, truncated and next_offset (the offset of the next slice, null at the end), text_source (api = API text, pdf = PDF text layer, ocr = local OCR), pdf_url, source_url, pii_flags (strings shaped like personal data counted in the text; the Court anonymises before publication). No row means the decision is not in the corpus. Case law is not a source of law by itself. Example: {"cislo": "8Cdo/21/2014", "offset": 20000}.
